# The Super 30

> AI-driven digital marketing agency in Bangalore offering SEO, lead generation, paid ads, social media, content, design, video and web development services for Indian and global brands.

The Super 30 is a Bangalore-based digital marketing agency combining AI tooling with a 30+ member expert team. Services span AI SEO, performance marketing, lead generation, social media, creative design, content writing, messaging (SMS/WhatsApp/RCS), video production and website development. Contact: +91 89041 50555.
